profile.headline: S-SRE II. You havent seen me, but maybe you've seen my work.

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Vendor cross-connects, hybrid cloud, troubleshooting, custom monitoring, software development - frontend/vue and backed/kotlin, Cisco, Fortigate, CentOS, Proxmox infrastructure, Physical presence in multiple datacenters, specialized HFT hardware. I keep my phone ON at night - and I was never awaken in 3, no... 1 year.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Ecommerce web applications development(angular, java, ruby on rails, 3rd party apis), continious maintenance, dev/ops. Practicing Scrum, TDD and CI.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description: Analysis, Implementation and Support of three E-commerce applications. Domain Experience and profiency in angularjs, nodejs ruby on rails and mysql.
